title: Share
link_hint: The whole design lives inside the link – it is never uploaded or stored anywhere. Anyone opening it can view it and remix it in their own editor.
images_left_out: {n} own image(s) are not included – the recipient sees placeholders and inserts their own pictures.
privacy: Anyone with the link can see the design. Don't put personal data into texts.
file_hint: With images: share the finished PNG or the project file (to keep editing) e.g. via Discord or WhatsApp. On desktop the file is downloaded.
invalid_text: This link is damaged or incomplete. It may have been cut off while copying.
has_placeholders: Contains {n} image placeholder(s) – insert your own pictures in the editor.
local_note: The design is only opened in your browser. None of it is on a server.
